items.claim: Ian Garry utilizes his height and long range very effectively with tools like oblique kicks.
items.quote: he's a tall lanky guy, long range, and he uses that range really well. Oblique kicks

items.claim: Ian Garry is a large welterweight, bigger than anyone Islam Makhachev has fought previously.
items.quote: Garry's a rangy guy, bigger than anybody Makhachev's fought before.

items.claim: Ian Garry possesses elite fight IQ and striking.
items.quote: he's got elite fight IQ, some of the best in the game. His striking is elite

items.claim: Ian Garry is highly capable on the ground and has successfully beaten both grapplers and strikers.
items.quote: he's more than capable on the ground. He has beat grapplers. He has beat strikers.

items.claim: Ian Garry is the only fighter to take Shavkat Rakhmonov to a decision.
items.quote: That's the only guy to take Shavkat to a decision.

items.claim: Ian Garry is the only fighter to defeat Carlos Prates in the UFC.
items.quote: The only guy to beat Carlos Prates in the UFC.
